text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You know that solo training of mine you 
wanted to see, Craft? I sent you a video 
clip of it, so take a look, okay?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! I'd been wondering about that 
forever! ...Wait, doing high knees at this 
speed!? And lifting your legs that high!?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Whaaah... Just watching makes my own 
thighs start trembling...! Hnnngh! That 
looks so brutal!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...I think I get it now. Why you're so 
strong, Heart-san... Do you always do 
stuff like this?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Twenty seconds of different training 
exercises, followed by a ten-second 
rest—repeated sixteen times. Its 
effectiveness is guaranteed, but it's pure 
hell.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. Want me to tell you the details? If 
you wish, I could even coach you, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Really!? Teach me, teach me!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Sure!! In that case, let's see... Come to 
the gym tomorrow. Then—"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I wanna do it right now! Training—as soon 
as possible, even by a single second!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Because I absolutely want to become a 
Tiara Umamusume! Whatever I can do today, 
I want to do right now!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Haha. Ahahaha! Yes, that's right! 
That's Rhein Kraft for you!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Then let's head straight to the gym. Come 
on, time waits for no one! Right?
